title: OpenEPCIS Battery Vocabulary Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating Battery Digital Product Passport data per EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542. Version 0.9.6.

Battery.title: Battery
Battery.description: A rechargeable battery as defined by EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542. Aligned with BatteryPass-Ready Data Attribute Longlist v1.3 (March 2026).

batteryModelIdentifier.description: Manufacturer-assigned model identifier. Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #7.

batterySerialNumber.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number of the individual battery item. Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #8.

facilityIdentifier.description: Identifier of the manufacturing facility (recommend GLN). Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #11.

operatorIdentifier.description: Economic operator identifier. Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #9.

manufacturerIdentifier.description: Manufacturer identifier (recommend GLN). Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #10.

manufacturerInformation.description: Manufacturer non-identifier metadata. Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #13.

schemaVersion.description: DPP schema version (e.g. "1.3"). Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #1.

dppStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the DPP. Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #2.

granularity.description: Reporting granularity of the DPP. Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #3.

lastUpdate.description: Date-time of latest update of DPP. Mandatory per BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #4.

hasBatteryChemistry.description: Recommended — Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Annex XIII public data point: the electrochemical system of the battery (cathode, anode, electrolyte composition).

batteryPassportIdentifier.description: Recommended — Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Art. 77(3) / Annex XIII: unique identifier of the battery passport; in this implementation the GS1 Digital Link URI (@id) is the primary identifier.

hasBatteryMass.description: Recommended — Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Annex VI Part A weight declaration: net mass of the battery in kilograms (unitCode KGM).

hasExpectedLifetime.description: Recommended — manufacturer-declared expected service life (BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 Performance submodel; ESPR Art. 7 durability declaration).

hasCarbonFootprintDeclaration.description: Recommended — Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Art. 7 / Annex II: carbon footprint declaration per battery model and manufacturing plant, phased in per battery category; a public passport data point (Annex XIII).

hasMaterialComposition.description: Recommended — Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Annex XIII: materials used in battery construction with percentages, locations and critical-raw-material status; underpins the Art. 8 recycled-content duties.

hasHazardousSubstances.description: Recommended — hazardous substances contained in the battery, classified per CLP (EC) 1272/2008, as required by Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 Annex VI Part A.

DPPStatus.title: DPP Status
DPPStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the Digital Product Passport per EN 18222. Suspended added in v1.3 alignment.

DPPGranularity.title: DPP Granularity
DPPGranularity.description: Reporting granularity introduced by BatteryPass-Ready v1.3.

BatteryCategory.title: Battery Category
BatteryCategory.description: Categories of batteries as defined by EU Battery Regulation.

BatteryChemistry.title: Battery Chemistry
BatteryChemistry.description: The electrochemical system of the battery including cathode, anode, and electrolyte materials.

shortName.description: Abbreviated chemistry name (e.g., LFP, NMC, NCA).

fullName.description: Full chemical name of the battery chemistry.

TechnicalSpecification.title: Technical Specification
TechnicalSpecification.description: Technical specifications of a battery including capacity, voltage, and performance parameters.

expectedCycleLife.description: Expected number of full charge-discharge cycles.

BatteryMaterial.title: Battery Material
BatteryMaterial.description: A material used in battery construction with its composition percentage and CAS identifier.

isCriticalRawMaterial.description: Whether this material is on the EU Critical Raw Materials list.

RecycledContent.title: Recycled Content
RecycledContent.description: Declaration of recycled material content in the battery.

leadRecycledShare.description: Combined pre/post-consumer recycled lead share. The EU Battery Regulation does not split this for lead (BatteryPass-Ready v1.3 #54).

EndOfLifeInfo.title: End of Life Information
EndOfLifeInfo.description: Information required for safe handling, dismantling, and recycling at end of battery life.

HazardousSubstance.title: Hazardous Substance
HazardousSubstance.description: A hazardous substance present in the battery, classified per EU CLP Regulation 1272/2008.

HazardClass.title: Hazard Class
HazardClass.description: Hazard classification categories per EU CLP Regulation.

OperatorInformation.title: Operator Information
OperatorInformation.description: Economic operator information as required by EU Battery Regulation Art. 38.

hasOperatorRole.description: Role of the economic operator (manufacturer, importer, distributor).

SupplyChainDueDiligence.title: Supply Chain Due Diligence
SupplyChainDueDiligence.description: Supply chain due diligence information as required by EU Battery Regulation Art. 39.

dueDiligenceReportUrl.description: URL to the supply chain due diligence report (REQUIRED).

Label.title: Label
Label.description: A label or marking on the battery as required by EU Battery Regulation Annex VI.

DismantlingDocument.title: Dismantling Document
DismantlingDocument.description: A document supporting battery dismantling, as specified in DIN DKE SPEC 99100.

hasSupplierContact.description: Contact information for the spare part supplier.

QuantitativeValue.title: Quantitative Value
QuantitativeValue.description: A point value or interval for measurement (gs1:QuantitativeValue).
